crossRefs.note: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of Yahweh be on you. We bless you in Yahweh’s name.”

translations.web: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,
translations.bsb: Have you never asked those who travel the roads? Do you not accept their reports?
translations.kjv: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,
translations.asv: Have ye not asked wayfaring men? And do ye not know their evidences,
